name: @corbits-builder/cloudflare
description: Checks that the app is ready to deploy to Cloudflare Workers.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants the app on Cloudflare Workers, or asks whether it is ready to go there.
builder.unless: The app is meant for another host.

routes.when: Once the app is ready for Cloudflare, before deploying it to the person's own domain, which a Worker answers only through a route.

steps.title: Check the app is ready for Cloudflare
Check the Worker is routed to a domain

facts.ready:cloudflare: the app has what a Cloudflare Workers deploy needs and the person approved its build plan
facts.routed:cloudflare: the app's wrangler.toml routes the Worker to a domain
